scope: Local actual Fastify inject GET routes, original RootAuthority/authentication/access policies and SQL; isolated PostgreSQL16 TEST data only. No ECS/online claims.
method: Two sequential before→after rounds on the same unchanged fixture; one warmup then five measured requests per scenario each round; ten samples per version. p50 median; p95 nearest-rank max of10. SQL includes request authentication/authority, BEGIN/asOf/COMMIT, not setup. No local regression suite ran concurrently with samples.

responseParity.covers: HTTP status, permission-denied result, total/page/order IDs, full authorized JSON including KPI/risks/stages/current+historical records and record URLs; only facts present in this TEST fixture.

browser.scope: Actual built App from PR08, unchanged cockpit frontend; isolated TEST API responses from independently measured PostgreSQL routes
